complexity.notes: The approach breaks if any input string contains the emoji delimiter itself; a length-prefix scheme would be more robust. Also, decoding the empty string works only incidentally via pop on the single empty split piece — an explicit guard would be clearer.
complexity.summary: Encodes by joining all strings with an emoji delimiter (plus a trailing delimiter), and decodes by splitting on that delimiter and dropping the empty trailing piece. Both operations are linear scans over the total character volume, which is O(n) since string lengths are bounded.
